# Lab 1.2: Explore Public Datasets

## What We Are Going to Do
Star the `bigquery-public-data` project, browse its datasets, and look at table details and previews without running a query.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Star the public data project.** In **Studio**, in the **Explorer** pane, click **+ Add data → Star a project by name**, type `bigquery-public-data` and click **Star**.

2. **[Console] Open a table.** Expand `bigquery-public-data → samples → shakespeare`. Look at the **Schema**, **Details** (number of rows, size, location `US`) and **Preview** tabs.

   **Preview is free.** It reads the table directly, so no query is billed.

3. **[CLI] Do the same from Cloud Shell.**

bq show --format=prettyjson bigquery-public-data:samples.shakespeare | head -30
bq head -n 5 bigquery-public-data:samples.shakespeare</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `bq head` reads rows like Preview does, so it is also free.

4. **[Console] Search for data.** In the Explorer search box type `citibike`, then switch the scope to **All projects** to find `new_york_citibike`.

5. **[Console] Discover more datasets.** Click **+ Add data → Public datasets** to open the Marketplace catalogue. Open any dataset and click **View dataset**.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Starred project | `bigquery-public-data` in Explorer |
| Table preview | Rows shown at no cost |
| Dataset location | `US` multi-region |
| CLI | `bq show` and `bq head` give the same information |
